lead.headline: Sadiq limited, and there's no second tight end
lead.deck: The rookie was limited Wednesday with an undisclosed injury. If he sits, the fix is Mark Andrews off the wire, free after Thursday 01:00.
lead.body: Kenyon Sadiq, your only tight end, was limited in Wednesday's practice and ESPN now lists him questionable; RotoWire can't say whether it's new or linked to his offseason hernia surgery. No one on the bench can play the slot, so the plan is off the wire: if Sadiq is ruled out Friday or inactive at 09:30 Sunday, add Mark Andrews once he clears to free agency Thursday at 01:00, and drop Carnell Tate. Don't claim him; priority is 8th and never resets. The rest is set. You moved Josh Downs into the flex this afternoon, and the lineup as set is now the projection lineup; the kicker and defence changed today too, to Jason Myers and the Ravens. The Lamar trade row is closed: Lamar is on Baltimore's report with a back issue, which was one of its own conditions. ESPN has you at 124.2 against Team 13's 112.3.
